title: PlayStation State of Play September 2026 - 15 Biggest Games, Reveals And Surprises

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Blood of Dawnwalker is finally here, and players are finally unleashed to explore Vale Sangora with abandon, reckless or otherwise. Coen's quest to save his family spans a fairly large world, but time isn't on his side since he only has 30 days. And while you could play it by ear - maybe even challenge Brencis close to the start - there are other ways to find success.

Here are 15 tips to keep in mind and become an efficient Dawnwalker.
title: The Blood of Dawnwalker - 15 Things I Wish I Knew Before Starting It

author: GamingBolt
description:
After a prolonged hiatus and years of restless anticipation, the Onimusha franchise is finally back with Onimusha: Way of the Sword- and it proves to be worth that long wait. The developer has delivered yet another excellent action title, offering a mechanically complex, challenging, and satisfying experience with plenty for players to juggle and master. 

Obviously, overcoming grueling challenges remains a big part of the experience in Way of the Sword from beginning to end, but to make those early hours just a little bit smoother, here, we have compiled a few basic tips and tricks that you should keep in mind as you dive into the game. With all that said, let’s get started.
title: Onimusha Way of the Sword - 15 Things It Doesn't Tell You
